reader.requirement: At --std 85 every report-name-1 of a TERMINATE statement must be the name of a report description entry (RD) in the Report Section; any other name must be refused, and several names are legal.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.Has(2002): a contained program's TERMINATE of a container's report needs a GLOBAL FD at 2002+; skipped at 85

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel/Edition.Has over ReportWriterBinder.cs; the Reports.Named lookup enforcing SR1 has no edition switch; TERMINATE is reserved at every edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for SR1; yes on the same statement for the 2002+ FD GLOBAL rule, correctly skipped at 85.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f31_04 exercises the legal multi-name form; the refusal half and the contained-program form come from probes p3initterm and p6glob.

probes.printed: COBOL1757 'report-name-1 shall be defined by a report description entry' for PRT, DTL, DTL-COL, WS-X, SQ, NOSUCH, the second operand of 'TERMINATE RPT WS-X', MAIN-PARA
probes.expected: every operand that is not an RD name refused (§1985:XIII.4.7.3 SR1)

probes.printed: TERMINATE R-C R-B R-A: END B then END A; R-C (no GENERATE) produces nothing
probes.expected: several RD names accepted, each terminated in order (§1985:XIII.4.7.4 GR2 for R-C)

probes.printed: --std 85 compiles and runs; --std 2023 COBOL2392 at TERMINATE RPT (§2023:14.9.46.3 SR2)
probes.expected: 1985: a GLOBAL report-name is an RD name the contained program may TERMINATE

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.4.7.3 SR1  (4.7.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1
OK  §1985:XIII.4.7.4 GR2  (4.7.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: BindTerminate is the INITIATE twin: the same report lookup and COBOL1757 refusal, with the 2002+ FD GLOBAL rule correctly off at 85. Diagnostics cite §2023:14.9.46.3 SR1 at --std 85.

refuter.evidence: Probe refute-1985-166/r3init.cob at --std 85 (runs/r3init-001): 'TERMINATE RIN' in the container (RD of the contained program) and 'TERMINATE RPT' in the contained program (container's non-GLOBAL RD) each draw COBOL1757. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.7.3 SR1 (the text is in SR1).
